# Liftoff
> Growth acceleration platform for mobile app advertising, monetization, user acquisition, and revenue optimization.

Liftoff helps advertisers, publishers, game developers, and DSPs grow mobile businesses through app marketing, monetization, mediation, exchange, and creative solutions. This file highlights the most useful product, documentation, support, and company resources across vungle.com and related Liftoff properties.

## Platform Overview
- [Home](https://vungle.com/): Overview of Liftoff’s mobile growth platform and core solutions.
- [Solutions](https://vungle.com/solutions/): Entry point to advertiser, publisher, and partner solution areas.
- [Products](https://vungle.com/products/): Summary of Liftoff product offerings across acquisition and monetization.
- [Resources](https://vungle.com/resources/): Central hub for guides, reports, webinars, and educational content.
- [Blog](https://vungle.com/blog/): Articles and updates on mobile advertising, monetization, and industry trends.
- [Contact](https://vungle.com/contact/): Contact options for sales, partnerships, and general inquiries.

## Advertiser Solutions
- [Advertisers](https://vungle.com/solutions/advertisers/): Overview of solutions for mobile user acquisition and app growth.
- [Accelerate](https://vungle.com/products/accelerate/): Machine-learning driven user acquisition and performance marketing platform.
- [Creative Studio](https://vungle.com/products/creative-studio/): Creative production and optimization for mobile ad campaigns.
- [Direct](https://vungle.com/products/direct/): Self-serve campaign management for mobile app advertisers.
- [Intelligence](https://vungle.com/products/intelligence/): Market and competitive insights for app growth decision-making.
- [Creative Testing](https://vungle.com/resources/): Educational resources related to ad creative strategy and testing.

## Publisher Solutions
- [Publishers](https://vungle.com/solutions/publishers/): Overview of monetization solutions for app publishers and developers.
- [Monetize](https://vungle.com/products/monetize/): In-app monetization platform for rewarded, interstitial, and banner ads.
- [MAX Mediation](https://vungle.com/products/max/): Mediation platform for yield optimization and network management.
- [Exchange](https://vungle.com/products/exchange/): Programmatic marketplace connecting publishers with demand partners.
- [Creative Studio for Publishers](https://vungle.com/products/creative-studio/): Ad creative services supporting monetization and engagement goals.
- [Publisher Resources](https://vungle.com/resources/): Guides and reports for app monetization strategy and best practices.

## DSP and Partner Solutions
- [DSPs](https://vungle.com/solutions/dsps/): Solutions for demand-side platforms accessing mobile app inventory.
- [Exchange](https://vungle.com/products/exchange/): Programmatic exchange for mobile in-app advertising supply.
- [Partners](https://vungle.com/partners/): Partnership information for ecosystem and technology collaborators.
- [Supply Access](https://vungle.com/solutions/dsps/): Information on reaching premium mobile app inventory through Liftoff.
- [Programmatic Solutions](https://vungle.com/products/exchange/): Exchange-focused offering for bidding and demand integration.

## Product Documentation
- [Help Center](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us): Main support portal for product documentation and troubleshooting.
- [Monetize Documentation](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002273652-Monetize): Guides for SDK integration, ad formats, and monetization setup.
- [Exchange Documentation](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002273672-Exchange): Documentation for exchange integrations and partner workflows.
- [Advertiser Documentation](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002273692-Advertiser): Campaign setup, reporting, and advertiser platform guidance.
- [Developer FAQ](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us): Frequently asked questions for technical and operational issues.
- [Submit a Request](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact support for account, technical, or product issues.

- [iOS SDK](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002273652-Monetize): iOS integration guidance for monetization implementations.
- [Ad Formats](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002273652-Monetize): Setup details for rewarded, interstitial, and banner ad units.

- [Exchange Integration](https://support.vungle.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002273672-Exchange): Technical onboarding information for exchange participants.
